# U10: Close the cycle: owners wrap up their goals, an admin starts the next cycle

- **Belongs to:** the Wrap-up module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `RETRO`, `CHANGE-LOG`, `ADMIN`
- **Budget:** at most 14 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Mateo, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U10

## Steps and checks

- _Note:_ Mateo owns two goals (the restore-time north star and its post-incident actions), so the wrap-up is two goals long.
- Open a fresh browser as Mateo (`mateo`).
- _Note:_ Seed the example in week 45, then come back in week 52, when the wrap-up opens.
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** The page’s lead shows.
- _Note:_ The demo example follows the calendar and never reaches the last two weeks of its year (it moves to a financial year instead), so the wrap-up is tried on a copy of it kept in this browser, as a workspace of the visitor's own.
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `async () => { const full = await window.__goalsStore.load('platform-org'); localStorage.setItem('goals-app-v2:workspaces', JSON.stringify([{ id: 'ws_wrap', name: 'Wrap-up team', kind: 'own', createdAt: '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' }])); localStorage.setItem('goals-app-v2:ws_wrap', JSON.stringify({ ...full, changes: [], checkIns: full.checkIns.filter((c) => c.week >= 42) })); localStorage.setItem('goals-app-workspace', 'ws_wrap'); localStorage.setItem('goals-app-viewer:ws_wrap', 'mateo'); }`.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all` in the demo on Tuesday 22 December 2026.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Wrap up” link is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Step.** Press the “Wrap up” link.
- **Check:** “goals to wrap up” is shown.
- **Check:** (`progress`) a progress indicator (a ring, steps, dots, a checklist or a bar) is visible.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “wrap-up”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the main button in the hero (`.hero .btn.primary`).
- **Check:** “How did it land?” is shown.
- Press the “Next: / Finish the wrap-up” button.
- **Check:** (`errors`) an alert showing “Write a sentence” is visible (else: a retro without a lesson is not explained).
- **Check:** (`attention`) the chip in the focus body (`.focus-body .chip`) is visible and there are 1 of the button (`[aria-labelledby=res-l] button[aria-pressed=true]`) (else: the retro does not show where the goal ended or suggest a result).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “retro”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Partly” button.
- **Step.** Type “Dependencies on other teams need a date agreed in week 1, not week 5.” into the “What did you learn?” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Next: / Finish the wrap-up” button.
- **Check:** “How did it land?” is shown.
- **Step.** Type “Action reviews only help once every incident has an owner for each action.” into the “What did you learn?” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Stop it here” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Next: / Finish the wrap-up” button.
- **Check:** “Your goals are wrapped up” is shown.
- **Check:** “Dependencies on other teams” is shown (else: the summary shows what was learned).
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `s.retros.length === 2 && s.changes.filter((c) => c.entity === 'retro' && c.actorId === 'mateo').length === 2`, where `let s = await h.snapshot('ws_wrap')`. Else it says: the retros are not saved and logged.
- _Note:_ Amara, an admin, starts the next cycle. (Home's admin card went with HM1; the workspace's line, HM7, brings "The wrap-up is open" back to an admin's Home.)
- Switch to Amara in the Demo panel (the quiet Demo button): a role card’s person, or anyone else by typing their name.
- _Note:_ Starting next year is its own page with a read-back (cycle-end 2.4); it prepares 2027 and moves nobody yet.
- Go to `/workspace/cycles/next` in the demo on Tuesday 22 December 2026.
- **Step.** Press the “Start 2027” button.
- **Check:** “2027 is ready” is shown.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `!!c2 && carried.length > 0 && carried.length < before && !carried.some((g) => g.title === 'Post-incident actions closed within 30 days')`, where `let s = await h.snapshot('ws_wrap')`; `const c2 = s.cycles.find((c) => c.id !== 'cycle')`; `const carried = s.goals.filter((g) => g.cycleId === c2?.id)`; `const before = s.goals.filter((g) => g.cycleId === 'cycle' && !g.stoppedAt && !g.removedAt).length`. Else it says: the next cycle does not carry the right goals.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `s.changes.some((c) => c.entity === 'cycle' && c.actorId === 'amara')`, where `let s = await h.snapshot('ws_wrap')`. Else it says: starting the cycle is not logged.
- _Note:_ On 4 January 2027 everyone is in 2027, with the goals that carried on.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all` in the demo on Monday 4 January 2027.
- **Check:** “Lead time for changes” is shown (else: the new cycle shows the carried goals).
- **Check:** It fails if a stopped goal came into the new cycle.
- Close this browser.
